integrity: Proof includes geometric classification, finite exhaustive enumeration and an integer rank/minor certificate. Scientific correctness, originality and value have self-review only; no independent audit or validation.
limitations: Exact Smith form only for the node-to-Jacobi-plane incidence map on the characteristic-two symmetric Burkhardt quartic. It does not identify divisor-class or Picard torsion, and historical priority remains qualified by an inaccessible early monograph article and more recent complete geometric presentations.
title: The integral order-two defect of the Burkhardt node–Jacobi-plane incidence lattice
